name: synthea-docs-site
description: Documentation site (Astro + Starlight) for the Synthea BPMN extension. Deliberately not an npm workspace: it is a documentation artefact, not part of the published package, and keeping it out of the workspace set keeps its dependency tree away from every other install. The pages under src/content/docs/guides etc. are generated from ../docs by scripts/sync-docs.mjs.
